description: This file defines the StructuredReference class, which handles parsing and managing structured table references in spreadsheet formulas within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for analyzing table references, extracting row and column ranges, and interacting with table objects in a spreadsheet.

classes.name: StructuredReference
classes.description: A class representing a structured table reference in spreadsheet formulas, capable of parsing, validating, and extracting cell ranges and references from structured table formulas.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new StructuredReference instance with a given structured reference string.

methods.name: fromParser
methods.description: Creates a StructuredReference object based on a formula string and regex matches, handling nested brackets.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the structured reference in the context of a cell, returning the cell range.

methods.name: isRowReference
methods.description: Determines if the reference is a row-specific reference based on special tokens.

methods.name: getTableStructure
methods.description: Gathers details about the table involved in the reference, such as range boundaries and header/totals rows.

methods.name: getTableForCell
methods.description: Finds the table that contains a specific cell, if no name is provided.

methods.name: getTableByName
methods.description: Retrieves a table object by its name within the worksheet.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Gets the column headers for the table, used for reference calculations.

methods.name: getRowReference
methods.description: Generates a row-specific cell reference based on item specifiers like '#Data' or '#Totals'.

methods.name: adjustRowReference
methods.description: Adjusts a row reference based on table headers and special tokens.

methods.name: getColumnReference
methods.description: Generates a column-specific cell reference range.

methods.name: validateParsedReference
methods.description: Validates that the parsed cell reference matches expected formulas, throws exception if not.

methods.name: fullData
methods.description: Constructs a data range string for the entire table based on start and end rows.

methods.name: getMinimumRow
methods.description: Determines the minimal row number for a given item specifier.

methods.name: getMaximumRow
methods.description: Determines the maximum row number for a given item specifier.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the original structured reference string.

methods.name: getRowsForColumnReference
methods.description: Determines the start and end rows for a column reference, based on item specifiers.

methods.name: getColumnsForColumnReference
methods.description: Replaces column headers in references with actual cell ranges.
